verdict.rationale: Google Workspace has documented walkthroughs for setting up custom SAML apps not in the pre-integrated catalog (docs-18, docs-25) and for third-party provisioning (docs-13, docs-26), directly matching the SAML-catalog-gap use case. However, there is no evidence of documented OIDC custom app configuration or header-based SSO support, which the story explicitly requires alongside SAML. Missing for 10: OIDC custom app walkthrough, header-based auth support/documentation, and independent corroboration of the SAML setup process working smoothly.
